purpose: Execute the atomic create-named-selection operation within the MA-33 boundary: Root-only create-only face named-selection group. It does not rename the group, select edges/bodies, or edit component occurrences.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-named-selection and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: faces
inputs.description: Nonempty distinct current root-part face references to place in one named-selection group.

preconditions: faces is nonempty, distinct, and every face belongs to the refreshed current root-body face collections.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The CreatedNamedSelection returned by NamedSelection.Create; it may have a generated name until MA-34.

postconditions: CreatedNamedSelection is not None and is returned.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic create-named-selection operation within the MA-33 boundary: Root-only create-only face named-selection group. It does not rename the group, select edges/bodies, or edit component occurrences. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Current root faces are enumerated before creation; callers must refresh topology after any later mutation.

failure_modes.detection: Empty, duplicate, or noncurrent face references raise ValueError.

failure_modes.condition: NamedSelection reports failure or returns no CreatedNamedSelection.
failure_modes.detection: NamedSelection reports failure or returns no CreatedNamedSelection.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate current faces and supply a distinct valid member set.
